mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 328i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace an engine in a BMW 328i varies significantly by generation. For M52B28/M52TUB28 straight-six engines in the E36/E46, rebuilt units range from £3,000-£5,500. For N20B20 turbo four-cylinders in the F30, rebuilt units range from £4,000-£6,500. Used engines start from around £600, while reconditioned units fall in the £1,500-£4,000 bracket. Specialist fitting adds approximately £600-£1,000 in labour.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain failure in a BMW 328i (N20 engine)?

acceptedAnswer.text: The N20 engine in the F30 328i is notorious for timing chain guide failure. The most common early warning sign is a metallic rattling noise from the engine, particularly on cold start or at idle. Other symptoms include a check engine light, reduced performance, and in severe cases, complete engine failure.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 328i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The answer depends entirely on your 328i's generation and condition. For E36/E46 328i models worth £3,000-£8,000, a full engine replacement (£3,000-£5,500) is borderline and only makes sense if the car is in exceptional condition. For F30 328i models worth £6,000-£14,000, replacement is more viable but still requires careful consideration.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the M52B28 and M52TUB28 engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The M52B28 (1995-1998) features single-VANOS on the intake camshaft and an aluminium block with Nikasil cylinder lining. The M52TUB28 (1998-2000) introduced Double-VANOS (on both intake and exhaust camshafts), cast-iron cylinder liners for improved durability, and revised camshafts.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 328i engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full engine replacement on a BMW 328i typically takes 1-2 days for a specialist workshop, assuming the replacement engine is on hand. E36/E46 M52 straight-six swaps are well-understood by BMW specialists, while F30 N20 swaps require additional expertise due to the turbocharged architecture.

mainEntity.name: Can I still get a replacement engine for a BMW 328i?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. While the M52B28, M52TUB28, and N20B20 are no longer in production, used, reconditioned, and rebuilt units remain readily available through UK engine specialists. EnginesMarket connects you with vetted suppliers who stock engines for all 328i generations - from the E36 through to the F30.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 3 Series 328i - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 328i has been one of the most celebrated nameplates in the 3 Series range, spanning four generations and three distinct engine families. From the naturally aspirated straight-six M52 in the E36 and E46 through to the turbocharged four-cylinder N20 and B48 in the E90 and F30, the 328i badge has consistently delivered a compelling blend of performance and refinement.

milestones.description: M52B28, 2.8-litre straight-six, 190 hp - E36 328i launched (saloon, coupé, convertible)
M52TUB28 (Technical Update), 2.8-litre straight-six with Double-VANOS, 193 hp - E46 328i launched
E46 328i production ends; replaced by 330i with M54B30
N52B30, 3.0-litre straight-six, 230 hp - E90 328i launched (US market only; UK 328i badge absent)
N20B20, 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder, 245 hp - F30 328i launched
B48B20, 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder, 248 hp - F30 LCI 328i replaced by 330i

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the BMW 3 Series 328i is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: BMW 3 Series 328i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 328i has been powered by three very different engine families across its production life - the M52 straight-six in the E36 and E46, and the turbocharged N20 and B48 four-cylinders in the F30. While all are capable of high mileages with proper maintenance, each has well-documented weaknesses that owners should understand. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Guide Failure - Why the N20 328i Engine Can Self-Destruct
problems.rootCause: The N20 engine's timing chain guides are made from a brittle plastic that can crack and break. When the guides fail, the timing chain loses tension, and because the N20 is an interference engine, the valves and pistons can collide, destroying the motor. A rattling noise from the engine at cold start or idle is the classic warning sign.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New timing chain, guides, tensioner - requires specialist tools
repairOptions.longevity: Best if caught early - before chain has slipped

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Complete rebuilt engine with upgraded timing components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If timing chain has failed causing internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical F30 328i is worth approximately £6,000-£14,000 depending on mileage and condition. Timing chain guide replacement (£1,200-£2,000 at specialist rates) is financially sensible and protects the engine. Full engine replacement is only justified if the car is in excellent condition with low mileage. If replacement cost exceeds 60% of vehicle value, evaluate scrap or part-exchange first.
problems.recommendation: If you hear a rattling noise from the front of the engine - particularly on cold start - act immediately. The N20 timing chain issue is well-documented and can write off an otherwise good car. A preventative chain guide replacement is far cheaper than a full engine rebuild.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 3 Series 328i N20 timing chain repair costs

problems.h4: Cooling System Failures - Overheating in the 328i
problems.rootCause: Across all 328i generations, the cooling system is a well-known weak point. In M52 engines, plastic water pump impellers and thermostat housings become brittle. In N20 engines, the water pump is rated to 60,000 miles but often fails earlier.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Water pump (metal impeller upgrade for M52), thermostat, expansion tank, hoses
Head skim, pressure test, or replacement head with new gasket
repairOptions.longevity: If overheating has caused head warping

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Complete rebuilt engine with upgraded cooling components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If overheating has caused bottom-end damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: E36 and E46 328i values typically range from £3,000-£8,000, while F30 328i values range from £6,000-£14,000. A cooling system overhaul (£350-£650) is excellent value preventative maintenance. Cylinder head replacement is borderline on lower-value examples. Full engine replacement is only recommended if the car has significant value or sentimental importance.
problems.recommendation: If you own any 328i, proactively overhaul the cooling system. For M52 engines, fit a metal-impeller water pump. For N20 engines, replace the water pump at 60,000 miles regardless of condition. This is cheap insurance against a warped head.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 3 Series 328i cooling system repair costs

problems.h4: VANOS System Failure - Rough Idle & Power Loss (E36/E46 328i)
problems.rootCause: The VANOS system controls variable valve timing. Over time, the VANOS seals degrade, allowing oil pressure to drop and preventing proper camshaft adjustment. Symptoms include rough idle, hesitation, stalling, and increased fuel consumption.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New VANOS seals (upgraded Viton seals), solenoid cleaning
Complete VANOS unit with new seals and solenoids
repairOptions.longevity: If seals have failed and caused internal wear

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Complete rebuilt engine with rebuilt VANOS, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If VANOS failure has caused timing-related damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: E36 and E46 328i values typically range from £3,000-£8,000. VANOS seal replacement (£300-£600) is financially sensible. Full VANOS unit replacement (£700-£1,200) is justifiable on a well-maintained example.
problems.recommendation: VANOS seal failure is almost inevitable on high-mileage M52 engines. Replacing the seals with upgraded aftermarket units is a cost-effective repair that restores lost power and economy.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 3 Series 328i VANOS repair costs
